tools.b: Browser-native sandbox from Leaning Technologies that runs Linux applications (Node, Rust, C++, Python preview) compiled to Wasm, with a persistent virtual filesystem, controlled networking, parallelism and multithreading - its makers call it an OS kernel for the web platform.
